cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline, CPU-only retrieval-augmented document Q&A for Ugandan SMEs: the model answers questions from a company's own PDFs (terms, policies, contracts) with citations, fully on-device on the 8 GB budget laptop — legal/commercial self-service without connectivity.

test_prompts.prompt: A supplier agreement says: 'A buyer may terminate this contract for any delivery that is more than 10 days late, provided the buyer first gives the supplier written notice.' The buyer wants to end the contract after a delivery arrived 12 days late. What must the buyer do first, and what is the exact trigger for the right to terminate?

List the essential clauses a small business's returns and refunds policy should include (for example a returns window, proof of purchase, non-returnable categories, refund method, and shipping responsibility), and explain in one sentence why each clause matters to a customer.
